title: 写一份“我的工作使用说明书”，让同事更了解你
topic: 写一份“我的工作使用说明书”，让同事更了解你

source.title: How to create a personal user manual for work | Atlassian
source.section: How to write a user manual
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课选取 Atlassian My User Manual Play 的个人工作说明书提示：说明工作条件、沟通和反馈偏好，并遵守自愿分享的安全规则。
paragraphs: A personal user manual for work is a document that outlines an individual's work style, preferences, strengths, and communication habits.

You should create a user manual at work when joining a new team, taking on a leadership role, or starting a project that requires close collaboration. It can also be useful during team-building activities or when communication issues arise. Essentially, it's beneficial anytime you want to improve clarity and teamwork with colleagues.

Before the meeting, ask each team member to fill out a user manual using one of the provided templates or by creating their own. Let them know that they can choose to answer the prompts they feel comfortable sharing. Here are some ideas to get them started:
What is your work and life set up?
What work hours do you keep?
What are the best ways to communicate with you?
What communication channels do you prefer?
How do you like to receive feedback?
What formats for feedback work for you?
This activity is designed for team members to understand how to support each other’s ideal conditions for getting their best work done.
No one will be pressured to share anything they’re not comfortable sharing.
This meeting is a safe space. Nothing they share will be used against them.
Each team member shares their user manual with the team and answers any questions teammates have on the content.
Keep your team’s user manuals archived in your team's Confluence space or other file-sharing space so future teammates can quickly learn.
For a shorter meeting, try limiting the template to questions about working hours, ideal environment, communication preferences, and learning styles before discussing anything longer and deeper.
translations: 个人工作说明书介绍一个人的工作方式、偏好、优势和沟通习惯。
加入新团队、承担领导角色或启动需要紧密协作的项目时，可以在工作中撰写说明书。团队建设活动或出现沟通问题时也适用；任何希望改善协作清晰度的场合都可以用。
会前请每位成员用提供的模板或自选格式填写说明书。要告诉大家：只需回答自己愿意分享的问题。下面是一些提示：
你的工作和生活安排是什么样的？
你通常的工作时间是什么？
哪些方式最适合与你沟通？
这项活动帮助团队成员了解彼此发挥最佳工作状态所需的条件，并据此互相支持。
没人会被迫分享自己不愿意公开的内容。
这是一个安全空间；分享的内容不会被拿来对付分享者。
每位成员向团队介绍自己的工作说明书，并回答同事关于内容的问题。
把团队说明书保存在 Confluence 团队空间或其他文件共享空间，方便未来加入的同事快速了解。
如果想缩短活动时间，可以先只讨论工作时间、理想环境、沟通偏好和学习方式，再决定是否深入讨论其他内容。
fullTextParagraphs: Personal user manuals are helpful tools for sharing your working style, communication preferences, and other details, making it easier for teams to work together.
Prep your user manual using a template.
Save your user manual to share with others in the future.
Video conferencing with screen sharing or meeting space.
Digital collaboration tool (see templates).
Help your teammates understand how best to work with you.
A personal user manual for work is a document that outlines an individual's work style, preferences, strengths, and communication habits.

Running the My User Manual Play creates a dedicated safe space for teams to reduce misunderstanding by clarifying expectations and sharing how best to collaborate with a specific co-worker. Research shows that making work process preferences explicit benefits collaboration.

You should create a user manual at work when joining a new team, taking on a leadership role, or starting a project that requires close collaboration. It can also be useful during team-building activities or when communication issues arise. Essentially, it's beneficial anytime you want to improve clarity and teamwork with colleagues.
Improved communication: It clarifies your preferred communication style, which research shows reduces misunderstandings and improves performance.
Stronger collaboration: Colleagues gain insights into how you work best, fostering more effective teamwork.
Faster onboarding: New team members can quickly understand your strengths, preferences, and work habits, speeding up integration.
Conflict prevention: By setting clear expectations, research shows you help prevent potential conflicts or frustration around work styles and interactions.
Increased productivity: When colleagues know how to engage with you efficiently, it reduces time spent on miscommunication and boosts overall productivity.

Before the meeting, ask each team member to fill out a user manual using one of the provided templates or by creating their own. Let them know that they can choose to answer the prompts they feel comfortable sharing. Here are some ideas to get them started:
USER MANUAL PROMPTS
Work
What is your work and life set up?
Where do you typically work from?
What work hours do you keep?
Communicate
What are the best ways to communicate with you?
What are the worst ways to communicate with you?
What communication channels do you prefer?
Feedback
How do you like to receive feedback?
What formats for feedback work for you?
Values
What are your top 3 values in life?
Achieve
What is your proudest achievement ever?
We’ve provided prompts in the template but we encourage you to make it your own with bold colors, plentiful memes, and random factoids.

Have team members join the meeting with their personal user manuals. For remote teams, setup a video conference with screen sharing. For in-person teams, have a meeting space that lets you share your user manual. If you’re sharing a physical copy, be sure to share a digital copy of your user manual as well. Next, share the rules for the Play.
This activity is designed for team members to understand how to support each other’s ideal conditions for getting their best work done.
No one will be pressured to share anything they’re not comfortable sharing.
This meeting is a safe space. Nothing they share will be used against them.
When new hires start, assign them the task of creating and presenting their user manual in their first 90 days.
Each team member shares their user manual with the team and answers any questions teammates have on the content.
Keep your team’s user manuals archived in your team's Confluence space or other file-sharing space so future teammates can quickly learn.
For a shorter meeting, try limiting the template to questions about working hours, ideal environment, communication preferences, and learning styles before discussing anything longer and deeper.
Have team members complete a personality test or training together, such as DiSC, Strengths Finder, or Myers-Briggs. Share and discuss the results as a team.

notes.phrase: work style, preferences, strengths, and communication habits
notes.meaning: 工作方式、偏好、优势和沟通习惯
notes.explain: 这是个人说明书可能涉及的内容；可以按需要选，不必每项都写。
notes.example: My work style and communication habits affect how I collaborate with the team.

notes.phrase: choose to answer the prompts they feel comfortable sharing
notes.meaning: 只回答自己愿意分享的问题
notes.explain: choose to 表示有选择权；feel comfortable sharing 表示分享边界由本人决定。
notes.example: You can choose to answer only the prompts you feel comfortable sharing.

notes.phrase: What are the best ways to communicate with you?
notes.meaning: 哪些沟通方式最适合你？
notes.explain: 用 best ways 询问对方偏好的沟通渠道或方式。
notes.example: What are the best ways to communicate with you during a busy week?

notes.phrase: archived in your team's Confluence space or other file-sharing space
notes.meaning: 归档在团队 Confluence 或其他文件共享空间
notes.explain: 说明保存位置，让未来加入的同事也能找到说明书。
notes.example: We keep the team manuals archived in our shared folder.

scenario.title: Writing your manual for a cross-functional team
english: Simulation: You are joining a cross-functional product team, and the group is preparing short work manuals.
Share one condition that helps you do your best work and explain how you prefer to receive feedback. You may skip any prompt you do not want to answer.
Invite teammates to refer to your manual in the shared team space, and let them know they can suggest a different way of working.
chinese: 模拟情境：你要加入一个跨职能产品团队，大家正准备撰写简短的工作说明书。
介绍一个有助于你发挥的工作条件，并说明你偏好的反馈方式。你可以跳过任何不愿回答的问题。
请同事在团队共享空间查阅你的说明书，并告诉他们也可以提出更适合的协作方式。

firstAttempt.prompt: 模拟情境：请写一段自己的工作说明书，说明什么条件有助于你发挥、你偏好怎样接收反馈，并邀请同事在需要时提出调整建议。只写你愿意分享的内容。
firstAttempt.sample: I do my best work when I have a quiet block to focus before a discussion. I prefer to receive feedback in writing before our one-on-one. Please let me know if a different format would work better for you. I’ll keep this manual in our shared team space and include only details I’m comfortable sharing.
firstAttempt.rationale: 工作说明书让同事了解与你协作的方式；来源提示是自愿回答，选择自己愿意分享的内容。

words.example: I’m creating a personal user manual to explain how I work best.
words.translation: 我正在写一份个人工作说明书，介绍什么方式最适合我工作。
words.note: 这里指介绍个人工作方式和沟通偏好的文档。

words.example: My communication preference is to receive feedback in writing first.
words.translation: 我的沟通偏好是先收到书面反馈。
words.note: 可以具体说明渠道、时间或反馈形式。

words.meaning: 愿意分享的；分享时感到自在的
words.example: Only include details you feel comfortable sharing.
words.translation: 只写你愿意分享的内容。
words.note: 说明个人说明书的分享边界；不是所有提示都必须回答。

structure.original: Let them know that they can choose to answer the prompts they feel comfortable sharing.
analysis: Let them know 是祈使句，表示“告诉他们”；that 引导 know 的宾语从句。
从句中 they 是主语，can choose 是带情态动词的谓语；choose to answer 表示选择回答。
the prompts they feel comfortable sharing 是 answer 的宾语；they feel comfortable sharing 修饰 prompts，强调只回答本人愿意分享的问题。
structure.transfer: You can skip any prompt you do not want to answer.

rewrite.bad: I am flexible about everything, so the team can decide how I should work.
rewrite.good: I do my best work when I have a quiet block to focus before a discussion. I prefer to receive feedback in writing before our one-on-one. Please let me know if a different format would work better for you. I’ll keep this manual in our shared team space and include only details I’m comfortable sharing.
rewrite.translation: 如果讨论前能留出一段安静的专注时间，我的工作状态最好。一对一沟通前，我更希望收到书面反馈。如果其他形式对你更合适，请告诉我。我会把说明书放在团队共享空间，只写自己愿意分享的内容。
rewrite.pattern: I do my best work when [condition]. I prefer to receive feedback [format]. Please let me know if [an adjustment] would work better for you.

cloze.prompt: I do my best work ___ I have time to focus before a discussion.
cloze.why: when 引出帮助自己发挥的工作条件。

cloze.prompt: I prefer to receive feedback in ___.
cloze.why: in writing 指书面形式，对应个人反馈偏好。

cloze.prompt: Please let me know ___ a different format would work better for you.
cloze.why: if 引出可供同事提出调整的情况。

choice.prompt: 新成员担心填写工作说明书时必须回答所有个人问题。哪条回复符合 Atlassian 的说明？
options: Everyone should answer every prompt so the team has complete information.
Choose the prompts you feel comfortable sharing, and save your manual in the shared team space so future teammates can find it.
Keep the manual private until a manager asks to see it.
choice.why: 来源说成员可以只回答愿意分享的问题，并建议将说明书存入共享空间。

output.prompt: 模拟迁移：你将加入客户支持团队的轮岗培训。请写一段自己的工作说明书：说明哪种条件帮助你准备培训、你偏好的反馈形式，并邀请同事在需要时提出调整。说明书将存入团队入职文件夹；只写你愿意分享的内容。
output.sample: I do my best work when I can review the agenda before a training session. I prefer to receive feedback in a short written note after the session. Please let me know if another approach would work better for the team. I’ll save my manual in the shared onboarding folder and include only details I’m comfortable sharing.
check: 是否说明有助于自己发挥的工作条件？
是否邀请同事提出可行的调整？
是否说明保存位置并尊重自愿分享边界？
